summary: Russian forces struck the SBU headquarters in Kyiv with a drone, wounding multiple personnel, while Ukraine declared a 'silence regime' to accommodate US envoy Witkoff and Kushner's diplomatic visits to Moscow and Kyiv. Ukrainian forces simultaneously struck Russian refineries and the Bastion coastal missile system in Crimea using Tsirkon and Oniks missiles. Massive Shahed drone barrages were reported across multiple fronts including Kyiv, Chernihiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Mykolaiv, and Odesa regions.
key_points: Russian drone struck SBU building in Kyiv; Zelensky confirmed the drone was aimed at the SBU chief's office, with multiple casualties reported. (Source: @UkraineNow/83888)
US envoys Witkoff and Kushner planned visits to Moscow and Kyiv; Ukraine declared a 'silence regime' suspending air strikes on Russia during their travel. (Source: @eRadarrua/110846)
Ukrainian forces struck two Russian refineries — Lukoil-Nizhnekamsknefteorgsintez and Novatek-Ust-Luga — on August 26 and September 1 using drone attacks. (Source: @UkraineNow/83885)
GUR forces struck the Russian Bastion coastal missile system in occupied Crimea using Tsirkon and Oniks missiles in August; video released September 4. (Source: @UkraineNow/83880)
Russian troops liberated the village of Gruzskoye northeast of Dobropolye, according to the Russian Ministry of Defense. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32998)
Massive Shahed drone launches were detected across multiple Ukrainian oblasts including Kyiv, Chernihiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Mykolaiv, Poltava, and Odesa regions. (Source: @kpszsu/76439)
Ukrainian USV MAGURA was equipped with STING drone interceptor launch pods (3x6 blocks, 18 interceptors) for counter-drone defense. (Source: @eRadarrua/110844)

ukraine: The SBU headquarters in Kyiv was struck by a Russian drone; President Zelensky confirmed the drone was directed at the SBU chief's office, with five to twelve people reported wounded depending on the source. (Source: @UkraineNow/83888)
All ground public transport in Kyiv was ordered to halt at 9:00 during a national minute of silence, with exceptions if air raid alarms are active. (Source: @UkraineNow/83881)
Ukrainian forces struck two Russian refineries — Lukoil-Nizhnekamsknefteorgsintez and Novatek-Ust-Luga — on August 26 and September 1, halting their operations. (Source: @UkraineNow/83885)

GUR forces struck the Russian Bastion coastal missile system in occupied Crimea using Tsirkon and Oniks missiles in August; video of the strike was published on September 4. (Source: @UkraineNow/83880)
The Ukrainian USV MAGURA was equipped with a STING drone interceptor launch system consisting of 3x6 blocks, enabling 18 counter-drone interceptors per vessel. (Source: @eRadarrua/110844)
Presidential advisor Shlef stated that no evidence of FPV drone use from reactive Shaheds in Kyiv was found over a three-day period. (Source: @UkraineNow/83879)
A fire broke out at ATB warehouses in the Odesa region following a Russian attack; in Kherson, Russian forces struck a bus with passengers, killing one and injuring five. (Source: @UkraineNow/83884)
russia: Russian forces liberated the village of Gruzskoye northeast of Dobropolye, according to the Russian Ministry of Defense. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32998)

The Bastion coastal missile system in occupied Crimea was struck by GUR forces using Tsirkon and Oniks missiles in August; Russia lost a key coastal defense asset. (Source: @UkraineNow/83880)
Russia directed an urgent appeal to ICAO Secretary-General regarding Ukraine's alleged threats to Russian civil aviation, demanding condemnation of Kyiv's actions. (Source: @tass_agency/393813)
Russia categorically rejected Ukrainian NOTAM notifications regarding alleged airspace safety concerns over Russian territory. (Source: @tass_agency/393783)
Putin held a meeting of the Russian Organizational Committee 'Victory' in VKS mode, signaling continued focus on the war effort. (Source: @tass_agency/393789)
Russian officials, including Naroshkin, stated that the West follows a 'divide and rule' logic attempting to drive a wedge between post-Soviet states. (Source: @tass_agency/393812)

sections.threat_assessment: The threat level for Kyiv and northern oblasts remains elevated with Shahed drone launches detected from multiple vectors including Crimea, Bryansk, and north Chernihiv. The 'silence regime' during diplomatic visits creates a temporary operational pause but may be exploited by Russian forces. The SBU headquarters strike demonstrates Russia's willingness to target critical Ukrainian institutions, while the Bastion missile system loss degrades Russia's coastal defense capabilities in Crimea.
sections.regional_response: Ukraine has declared a temporary 'silence regime' to facilitate US diplomatic efforts, with Witkoff and Kushner expected in Kyiv on Sunday. Hungary continues to provide protection for Ukrainian men of conscription age despite new EU restrictions. Russia has formally protested to ICAO regarding Ukraine's alleged interference with Russian civil aviation, while Ukraine maintains its position on airspace safety.
sections.intelligence_notes: The coincidence of the SBU headquarters strike and the diplomatic visit timing raises questions about Russian intent and potential signaling. The confirmed use of Tsirkon and Oniks anti-ship missiles against the Bastion system indicates Ukrainian forces have achieved significant strike capability against hardened coastal targets. The 'silence regime' duration is estimated to extend through approximately September 8 based on the travel timeline of US envoys.
